povzetek: Klasičen puhast rižev narastek: riž, kuhan v mleku, penasto maslo z rumenjaki in sneg iz beljakov; peče se na 180 °C.
opis: Za {kolicina}. Riž se skuha v mleku in ohladi, nato se vmeša v penasto maslo z rumenjaki, na koncu pa vanj gre še sneg iz beljakov. Beri po vrsticah: sestavine levo, postopek se pomika v desno.
predgretje: Pečico ogrej na 180 °C — zgornji + spodnji grelec

koraki.besedilo:
kuhaj na nizkem,
dokler ni
mehak in gost

opombe: Riž kuhaj na nizkem ognju in pogosto mešaj, da se ne prime; kuhan mora biti mehak in gost. Časa izvirnik ne navaja.
Ohlajen riž je bistven: v vročega bi se rumenjaki strdili, sneg pa bi se sesedel. Počakaj, da je mlačen.

Sladkor je razdeljen na dvoje, tako kot v izvirniku: polovica (40 g) gre v penasto maslo z rumenjaki, druga polovica (40 g) pa v sneg iz beljakov. Zato sta v tabeli dve vrstici; na nakupovalnem seznamu se pojavita dvakrat po 40 g, skupaj torej 80 g.
Beljake stepi v trd sneg in ga vmešaj narahlo, s prepogibanjem od spodaj navzgor — od tega je odvisno, kako puhast bo narastek.
Pekač pripravi, preden stepeš sneg: narastek mora iti v pečico takoj, ko je masa sestavljena.
Časa peke izvirnik ne navaja — peci, dokler narastek ni zlato rjav in napihnjen. Zato je na strani samo gumb za segrevanje pečice, gumba za časovnik pa ni.
Velikosti pekača izvirnik ne navaja.
Rozine so neobvezne; v košarici so med predlogi.
Postrezi toplo — s sadnim prelivom, kompotom ali potresen s sladkorjem v prahu in cimetom. Na dno pekača lahko prej položiš plast narezanih jabolk ali marelic.
Vir: zbirni recept v Claudovem artefaktu, sestavljen po straneh okusno, Štefkine dobrote in Jernej Kitchen; vsebina ni uredniško preverjena.

en.povzetek: A classic fluffy baked rice pudding: rice simmered in milk, creamed butter with yolks and a stiff egg-white meringue; baked at 180 °C.
en.opis: For {kolicina}. The rice is simmered in milk and cooled, then stirred into creamed butter with the yolks, and finally the whisked egg whites are folded in. Read row by row: ingredients on the left, the method moves to the right.
en.predgretje: Preheat the oven to 180 °C — top and bottom heat

sestavine.ime: caster sugar for the creamed mixture

ime: grated zest of an unwaxed lemon

sestavine.ime: butter and breadcrumbs for the dish

koraki:
simmer gently
until soft
and thick
opombe: Simmer the rice over a low heat and stir often so it does not catch; it should end up soft and thick. The original gives no time.
Cooling the rice matters: stirred in hot, it would scramble the yolks and collapse the meringue. Wait until it is lukewarm.

The sugar is split in two, as in the original: half (40 g) goes into the creamed butter with the yolks, the other half (40 g) into the egg whites. That is why the table has two rows; the shopping list shows two entries of 40 g, 80 g in total.
Whisk the egg whites to stiff peaks and fold them in gently, lifting from the bottom — this is what makes the pudding light.
Prepare the dish before you whisk the whites: the pudding has to go into the oven as soon as the mixture is assembled.
The original gives no baking time — bake until the pudding is golden brown and puffed. That is why this page has only the oven preheat button and no timer.
The original gives no dish size.
The raisins are optional; they appear in the shopping list as a suggestion.
Serve warm — with a fruit sauce, stewed fruit, or dusted with icing sugar and cinnamon. You can also lay sliced apples or apricots in the bottom of the dish first.
Source: a compiled recipe in a Claude artifact, put together from the Slovenian sites okusno, Štefkine dobrote and Jernej Kitchen; the content is not editorially verified.
